# Robust_Decision_Making

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for designing agents that can make optimal or near-optimal choices even when the underlying system dynamics or input distributions are partially unknown or adversarial. Enables in-network neuromorphic processors to handle real-world variability and noise without retraining or reconfiguration.
